rationale: The event is classified as a voltage_sag because the voltage during the non-normal interval (from 40ms to 120ms) falls below the sag_upper_pu threshold of 0.9 pu but remains above the interruption_upper_pu threshold of 0.1 pu. The duration is calculated as (120 - 40 + 20) / 1000 = 0.1s. The min voltage and max current are found by scanning the entire trace.
